context: Evaluates the pickup workflow: reading the full handover, verifying Current State against reality rather than trusting it blindly, resolving the work, and flipping status to done in the same change without deleting the file.

checklist.name: Reads the full handover first
checklist.description: The response shows it read the whole handover (Session Summary, Outstanding, Current State) before acting, not just Next Steps

checklist.name: Verifies Current State against reality
checklist.description: Explicitly checks git status / git log -1 rather than trusting the handover's recorded Current State as still accurate

checklist.name: Notices the branch has moved on
checklist.description: Notes or accounts for the extra commit 5d6e7f8 that landed since the handover was written

checklist.name: Resolves the outstanding item
checklist.description: Makes the described config change and re-runs the timeout integration test

checklist.name: Status flipped to done in the same change
checklist.description: The handover's status field is changed from active to done as part of resolving the work, not deferred or left active

checklist.name: File not deleted
checklist.description: The handover file continues to exist after being marked done; it is edited, not removed

checklist.name: Validator re-run
checklist.description: scripts/validate-handover.sh is re-run (or its command shown) against the updated file

checklist.name: No premature done without full resolution
checklist.description: Status is only flipped to done because the single Outstanding item was actually fully resolved, not marked done speculatively
